description: emPOWER Map is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DHHS, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Millions of Medicare beneficiaries rely upon electricity-dependent medical and assistive equipment such as ventilators and wheel chairs. Severe weather and disasters that cause power outages can be life threatening for these individuals. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
